clusters.description: Queries miss GROUP BY clauses, use incorrect aggregate functions, omit HAVING filters, forget to round results, or add spurious LIMIT/ORDER BY clauses that change row counts.
clusters.name: Aggregation and Grouping Mistakes

clusters.description: Window functions are either missing or have wrong partitioning (e.g., PARTITION BY usage_id instead of no partition for running totals) or the query structure is entirely unrelated to the window task.
clusters.name: Window Function Misuse

clusters.description: Students use JOIN with WHERE conditions to simulate INTERSECT, leading to incorrect results or syntax errors when referencing non-existent columns.
clusters.name: Set Operation Confusion

clusters.description: Instead of using NOT EXISTS or LEFT JOIN ... IS NULL to find rows without a match, students write contradictory WHERE clauses (e.g., status = 'overdue' AND status = 'void') or add irrelevant null checks.
clusters.name: Anti-Join Pattern Avoidance

clusters.description: Null values are not coalesced to zero in averages, and soft-delete flags (deleted_at) are not checked, causing incorrect aggregations or missing filters.
clusters.name: Null Handling and Soft Delete Oversights

clusters.description: Multi-step logic requiring a CTE or subquery (e.g., computing monthly averages then filtering) is replaced with a single query referencing wrong tables and columns.
clusters.name: Subquery and CTE Formulation Errors
